clauses.zh: 以靛蓝为主色，唯一醒目的橙红落在侧面音量旋钮。
clauses.en: Use indigo as the main color, with orange-red as the sole prominent accent at the side volume dial.

clauses.zh: 将细节集中在旋钮、指示刻度与相邻网面，外围保持疏朗。
clauses.en: Concentrate detail at the dial, tick marks, and adjacent grille and keep the surrounding area sparse.

clauses.zh: 用粗细分明的靛蓝线条与平面墨块塑形，米白纸面保留轻微纤维。
clauses.en: Build forms with indigo lines of distinct weights and flat ink shapes over lightly fibrous off-white paper.

clauses.zh: 以一台圆角便携音箱为主体，呈现正面网面与侧面音量旋钮的连接关系。
clauses.en: Feature a rounded portable speaker, depicting how the front grille meets the side volume dial.

clauses.zh: 场景为简洁的桌面陈列，后景只交代必要内容。
clauses.en: Set the image in a spare tabletop display, using only essential background detail.

clauses.zh: 用机身边缘和网面纹路把视线引向音量旋钮。
clauses.en: Guide attention to the volume dial with the enclosure edge and the grille pattern.
